title: Life on the Factory Floor
transcript:
Your project says workers welcomed the factory's new shift system. Which source led you to that conclusion?
Mostly the company newsletter. The editor printed comments from employees who liked finishing earlier on Fridays.
Those comments tell you something about the people quoted. Where could you look for a wider range of experiences?
The local archive has union minutes. I could check whether anyone raised concerns at the meetings.
Good. And before you compare the sources, make sure they cover the same period.
I've narrowed it to six months after the change. There are records from both sources throughout that period.
I noticed that all the workers quoted in your draft had permanent contracts. What about the others?
I haven't found any direct accounts from temporary staff.
Then limit your conclusion to the workers whose views you can document. You can identify the missing perspectives in your discussion.

questions.prompt: The initial conclusion was mainly based on the company ____.
questions.explanation: 学生说最初的判断主要依据公司简报刊登的员工意见。

questions.prompt: The student will consult union ____ for concerns raised at meetings.
questions.explanation: 学生打算查阅工会会议纪要，看看会上是否有人提出疑虑。

questions.prompt: The comparison covers the ____ following the change to the shift system.
questions.explanation: 学生把比较范围缩小到排班制度改变后的六个月。

questions.prompt: What did all the workers quoted in the draft have in common?
options: They worked on the same shift.
questions.explanation: 导师指出，草稿中引用的工人都签有长期合同。

questions.prompt: What does the tutor advise the student to do in the conclusion?
options: Use the reported views to estimate how most workers felt.
Give equal weight to the views of every group of workers.
Restrict the claim to workers whose views are documented.
questions.answer: Restrict the claim to workers whose views are documented.
questions.explanation: 导师建议把结论限定在有资料可证实其观点的工人范围内。
